==== aboard init --allow-commands ====
claude-code, everywhere:
  create    ~/.claude/skills/aboard/SKILL.md (skill)
  update    ~/.claude/settings.json (hooks)
            SessionStart: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code session-start
            UserPromptSubmit: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code prompt
            Stop: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code stop
            PostToolBatch: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code tool
            PreToolUse: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code pre-tool
            SessionEnd: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code end
            allow: Bash(aboard *)
codex, everywhere:
  create    ~/.agents/skills/aboard/SKILL.md (skill)
  update    ~/.codex/hooks.json (hooks)
            SessionStart: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex session-start
            UserPromptSubmit: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex prompt
            Stop: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex stop
            PreToolUse: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex tool
            SessionEnd: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex end
            (Codex 0.159.3 doesn't run Stop and PostToolUse; aboard doctor says what that leaves out)
  create    ~/.codex/rules/aboard.rules (permissions)
            prefix_rule(pattern=["aboard"], decision="allow")
            (Codex runs the commands it allows outside its sandbox.)
omp: not found on this machine
Run aboard init --yes --allow-commands to make these changes.
==== aboard init --yes --allow-commands --json ====
{
  "applied": true,
  "scope": "global",
  "delivery": null,
  "allow_commands": true,
  "harnesses": [
    {
      "name": "claude-code",
      "detected": true,
      "changes": [
        {
          "path": "{HOME}/.claude/skills/aboard/SKILL.md",
          "kind": "skill",
          "action": "create"
        },
        {
          "path": "{HOME}/.claude/settings.json",
          "kind": "hooks",
          "action": "update",
          "allow": [
            "Bash(aboard *)"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "codex",
      "detected": true,
      "changes": [
        {
          "path": "{HOME}/.agents/skills/aboard/SKILL.md",
          "kind": "skill",
          "action": "create"
        },
        {
          "path": "{HOME}/.codex/hooks.json",
          "kind": "hooks",
          "action": "update"
        },
        {
          "path": "{HOME}/.codex/rules/aboard.rules",
          "kind": "permissions",
          "action": "create",
          "allow": [
            "prefix_rule(pattern=[\"aboard\"], decision=\"allow\")"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "omp",
      "detected": false,
      "changes": []
    }
  ]
}
==== aboard init --yes --allow-commands (again) ====

==== file .agents/skills/aboard/SKILL.md ====
(the Aboard skill this aboard installs, byte for byte)
==== file .claude/settings.json ====
{
  "model": "opus",
  "permissions": {
    "allow": [
      "Bash(git status)",
      "Bash(aboard *)"
    ]
  },
  "hooks": {
    "Stop": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "say done"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code stop",
            "timeout": 86400,
            "asyncRewake": true
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code session-start",
            "timeout": 30
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "UserPromptSubmit": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code prompt",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "PostToolBatch": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code tool",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "PreToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Bash",
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code pre-tool",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "SessionEnd": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code end",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}

==== file .codex/hooks.json ====
{
  "hooks": {
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "matcher": "startup",
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "echo hello"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex session-start",
            "timeout": 30
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "UserPromptSubmit": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex prompt",
            "timeout": 10,
            "additionalContextLimit": 8192
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "Stop": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex stop",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "PreToolUse": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex tool",
            "timeout": 30,
            "additionalContextLimit": 8192
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "SessionEnd": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex end",
            "timeout": 3
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
==== file .codex/rules/aboard.rules ====
# Added by aboard init: run aboard commands without asking.
prefix_rule(pattern=["aboard"], decision="allow")
==== file .codex/rules/default.rules ====
prefix_rule(pattern=["git", "status"], decision="allow")

      "version": "{version}",
      "commit": "{commit}",
      "sha256": "{sha256}",
      "created": true
    },

      "path": "{HOME}/.claude/settings.json",
      "harness": "claude-code",
      "scope": "global",
      "kind": "hooks",
      "version": "{version}",

      "sha256": "{sha256}",
      "created": false,
      "allow_added": true
    },
